# Settings reference

<!-- Generated by `uv run python -m pybehaviour.settings_doc`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every task setting, with the name used in:

- the rig file, under `defaults:` (starting values for that rig),
- presets (`rigs/presets/<rig>/<name>.json`, under `"params"`),
- `session_config.json` (same names as the MATLAB `handles2give`).

In the GUI, hover over a field: the tooltip ends with its setting name. To build the block from the
GUI instead of by hand: set the values, then *Settings ▸ Export settings as rig defaults…*.

Example rig file section:

```yaml
defaults:
  lick_threshold: 0.05
  min_iti: 4000
  max_iti: 8000
  wh_stim_weight_1: 4
  no_stim_weight: 4
```

On/off settings take `true` / `false`. Values not listed keep the default below.

## Session

| Setting name | GUI label | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mouse_name` | Mouse name |  | MPXXX | Mouse ID; used in folder and file names. |
| `behaviour_directory` | Data folder |  | "" | Root folder for session data: `<folder>/<mouse>/<mouse>_<date>_<time>`. |
| `behaviour_type` | Behaviour type |  | free_licking | Training stage label, saved for analysis (e.g. whisker_psy). |
| `date` | Date |  | "" | Set automatically at session start. Never stored in presets. |
| `session_time` |  |  | "" | Set automatically at session start. Never stored in presets. |
| `mouse_weight_before` | Weight before | g | 0 | Never stored in presets. |
| `mouse_weight_after` | Weight after | g | 0 | Never stored in presets. |

## Session type

| Setting name | GUI label | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `twophoton_session` | Two-photon | on/off | false | Bookkeeping; also shows the galvo trace. |
| `threephoton_session` | Three-photon | on/off | false | Bookkeeping; also shows the galvo trace. |
| `wf_session` | Widefield | on/off | false | Bookkeeping only (widefield control not ported). |
| `extracell_ephys_session` | Extracell. ephys | on/off | false | Bookkeeping. |
| `intracell_ephys_session` | Intracell. ephys | on/off | false | Bookkeeping. |
| `chemo_session` | Chemo | on/off | false | Bookkeeping. |
| `pharma_session` | Pharma | on/off | false | Bookkeeping. |
| `dummy_session_flag` | Dummy session | on/off | false | Bookkeeping (test session). |
| `opto_session` | Optogenetics | on/off | false | Laser + galvo stimulation; settings in the Optogenetics window. |
| `ttl_session` | PdCO (TTL) | on/off | false | PdCO TTL pulses; settings in the PdCO window. |

## Camera

| Setting name | GUI label | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `camera_flag` | Camera ON | on/off | false | Enables the camera fields (the frame pulse train always runs, as in MATLAB). |
| `camera_freq` | Frame rate | Hz | 200 | Behaviour camera frame trigger rate. |
| `camera_exposure_time` | Exposure | ms | 2 | Width of each frame trigger pulse. |
| `camera_start_delay` | Start delay | s | 3 | Delay before the first frame trigger. |

## Trial timeline

| Setting name | GUI label | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `min_quiet_window` | Quiet window (from) | ms | 2000 | No lick for this long before a trial can start; drawn between min and max. |
| `max_quiet_window` | Quiet window (to) | ms | 5000 |  |
| `min_iti` | Inter-trial interval (from) | ms | 6000 | Time from the end of a trial to the next one; drawn between min and max. |
| `max_iti` | Inter-trial interval (to) | ms | 10000 |  |
| `baseline_window` | Baseline window | ms | 0 | Trial start to stimulus. A lick here is an early lick (trial aborted). |
| `artifact_window` | Artifact window | ms | 100 | After the stimulus; licks ignored. |
| `response_window` | Response window | ms | 1000 | Licks here are hits (stimulus) or false alarms (catch). |
| `trial_duration` | Trial duration | ms | 5000 | Length of the stimulus output; raised automatically to fit the windows. |
| `lick_threshold` | Lick threshold | V | 0.03 | Lick sensor level counted as a lick (above the live plot). |

## Mode

| Setting name | GUI label | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `association_flag` | Association | on/off | false | Free reward at stimulus onset, no lick needed. |

## Timeouts

| Setting name | GUI label | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `false_alarm_punish_flag` | False alarm timeout | on/off | false |  |
| `false_alarm_timeout` | False alarm timeout | ms | 0 | Extra wait after a false alarm. |
| `early_lick_punish_flag` | Early lick timeout | on/off | false |  |
| `early_lick_timeout` | Early lick timeout | ms | 0 | Added to the fixed 2 s pause after every early lick. |

## Passive stimulation

| Setting name | GUI label | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `passive_stim_flag_enable` | Passive stimulation: Enable | on/off | false |  |
| `passive_stim_flag` | Passive block ON | on/off | false | Runs a block of passive (unrewarded, association) trials. |
| `passive_trial_max` | Trials |  | 40 | Number of passive trials in the block. |

## Context

| Setting name | GUI label | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `context_flag` | Context task | on/off | false | Pink / brown noise blocks; whisker reward follows the mouse's rewarded context. |
| `context_block_size` | Max same-context blocks |  | 1 | Maximum consecutive blocks of the same context. |
| `context_table_directory` | Context table folder |  | "" | Folder with rewarded_context.csv. Not saved in session_config.json. |
| `bckg_noise_directory` | Noise folder |  | "" | Folder with pink_noise.wav and brown_noise.wav. Not saved in session_config.json. |
| `context_sound_on` | Play background noise | on/off | true |  |
| `pink_noise_gain_db` | Pink noise gain | dB | 0 | Gain applied to pink_noise.wav when it plays, to match the two noise levels (see Tools ▸ Sound calibration). Changes apply immediately, also during a session. |
| `brown_noise_gain_db` | Brown noise gain | dB | 0 | Same for brown_noise.wav. |
